label.zh: 格式塔目睹坠落的结果

note.zh: 基础权重5:5；分心/亚空间感应/委派职能公民使591×2，单一意志/统一凝聚使592×2。
note.en: Base 5:5; divided-attention / subspace-ephapse / delegated-functions civics double 591, one-mind / unitary-cohesion civics double 592.

label.zh: 每月随机事件（可重复、无固定顺序）

note.zh: 兵变“深渊致意”“黑暗之怖”不影响格式塔，同时只进行一项；“彭罗斯过程”需进度≥70，仅发生一次。
note.en: Mutinies (Hello Darkness, Fear of the Dark) never hit gestalts, and only one runs at a time. The Penrose Process needs progress 70+ and happens once.

note.zh: 空间站与舰队被摧毁；非格式塔-100影响力，格式塔可选择目睹坠落。
note.en: The station and its fleet are destroyed; non-gestalts lose 100 influence, gestalts may choose to witness the fall.

note.zh: 获得一位6级科学家（狂热、场操纵专长）。
note.en: Grants a level-6 scientist (Maniacal, field-manipulation expertise).

notes.zh: 每五年的随机国家检查（权重25/2335）运行隐藏500：须拥有建有黑洞观测站且为星辰要塞以上的黑洞星系，每个帝国一次。初始进度25；撤离每月净-5、维持轨道+2、前进+8（越靠近引力越强）。
notes.en: The five-year random country pulse (weight 25/2335) runs hidden 500: needs an owned black-hole system with a Black Hole Observatory on a star fortress or larger; once per empire. Starts at 25%; Retreat nets -5/month, Maintain Orbit +2, Advance +8 (the pull grows closer in).

scope.zh: 自由落体/重力井完整故事：入口、三种方式、每月随机事件（兵变、彭罗斯过程）、不归点、坠落与格式塔目睹、两种逃脱结局。
scope.en: Whole Free Fall / Gravity Well story: entry, the three approaches, monthly events (mutinies, Penrose process), point of no return, the fall and gestalt witnessing, both escape endings.
